question: Among customers who made transactions in the morning of August 26, 2012, paid in CZK, and belong to the SME, LAM, or KAM segment, which customer had the highest percentage increase in consumption from 2012 to 2013?

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-26'
      AND t.XCL_012 < '12:00:00'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND c.XCL_002 IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_001 IN (SELECT XCL_001 FROM qualifying_customers)
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    c.XCL_001
FROM consumption c
WHERE c.consumption_2012 > 0
ORDER BY ((c.consumption_2013 - c.consumption_2012) * 100.0) / c.consumption_2012 DESC
LIMIT 1

consumption AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_001 IN (SELECT XCL_001 FROM qualifying_customers)
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    c.XCL_001
FROM consumption c
WHERE c.consumption_2012 > 0
ORDER BY ((c.consumption_2013 - c.consumption_2012) * 100.0) / c.consumption_2012 DESC
LIMIT 1
